content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Centennial

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria now to confirm you meet education and experience requirements before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our nationwide cohorts meet on a schedule that fits working professionals. You'll complete the PMI-required 35 contact hours of formal education covering the PMBOK Guide and exam domains.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI will review your experience and credentials before you're authorized to sit.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam when ready through Pearson VUE. Our active certified practitioners have designed materials that reflect real-world project scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years to renew. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and resources to help you sustain and advance your credential throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
